caption: The drawing depicts a lion standing on a flat, tan-brown ground with a similarly colored tan background. The lion is shown in profile facing left, with a full, reddish-brown mane that has yellow highlights near the edges and darker brown shading near the face and chest. The lion's body is a deep reddish-brown color, with black lines subtly outlining its muscles and contours. Two front legs are straight, and the hind legs are slightly bent, with the right rear leg lifted as if in motion. The lion's tail curls upward and then downward, ending in a black tuft. The lion's face is detailed with round yellow eyes, a large nose, and a mouth outlined in black, with whisker dots visible. In the lower right, the name "Rice." is written in black. At the bottom of the image, a horizontal black panel bears the yellow text "A. PHELPS' INN." The image is bordered by a light brown frame.
title: Red Lion Inn Sign
